question: Simlipal Biosphere Reserve is located in which state?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Simlipal Biosphere Reserve is located in the northeastern part of Odisha state, India.
 
• It is part of the larger Simlipal Tiger Reserve, which was designated in 1973 as a Tiger Reserve under Project Tiger.
 
• The area is rich in biodiversity and is home to numerous species of flora and fauna, including tigers, elephants, and leopards.
 
• Simlipal Biosphere Reserve was added to the World Network of Biosphere Reserves by UNESCO in May 2009.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Odisha
 Location of Simlipal Biosphere Reserve.
 
 

 2) Assam
 Known for Kaziranga National Park and Manas National Park, both UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
 
 

 3) Jharkhand
 Home to Betla National Park and the Palamau Tiger Reserve.
 
 

 4) Bihar
 Valmiki National Park, part of the Valmiki Tiger Reserve, is located here.
